messages.name: Color
messages.description:
Represents a color in the RGB color space.
Each color component is an unsigned 32-bit integer value in the range [0, 255].

fields.name: red

fields.name: blue

messages.name: SetLEDColorRequest
messages.description: Request message for configuring the LED color and behavior

fields.name: duration
fields.description:
Duration for which the LED will maintain the requested color.
If blinking is enabled, this duration applies to the blinking cycle.
Default: 1s

fields.name: transition_time
fields.description:
Specifies the time for transitioning from the current color
to the new requested color. If omitted or zero, the transition is immediate.
Default: 0s

fields.name: blinking
fields.description:
Indicates whether to enable blinking
Default: False

fields.name: blinking_freq
fields.description:
Blinking frequency in Hz.
This field is only relevant if blinking is set to true.
Default: 1Hz

messages.name: SetLEDColorResponse
messages.description: Response message for the SetLEDColor RPC call

methods.name: SetLEDColor
methods.description:
Sets the LED color and (optionally) its blinking behavior.
If blinking is true, the LED blinks at 'blinking_freq' for 'duration'.
Otherwise, the LED remains in the requested color for 'duration'.
